subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should `sessions.abort` expose `clearQueued` as a supported public Gateway contract for Control UI selected-session Stop, with the explicit consequence that queued follow-up and lane work for that session is discarded?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but choosing whether a stop action may discard queued user work is a durable queue-policy and public RPC-contract decision rather than a safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve explicit queue clearing
options.body: Keep `clearQueued` as an additive opt-in parameter and merge after the owner confirms that selected-session Stop should discard that session's queued successor work.

options.title: Preserve queued work
options.body: Remove the queue-clearing behavior and limit the change to aborting the currently active selected-session run, allowing existing queued follow-up work to proceed.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open while the owner specifies a narrower owner-boundary API if queue clearing should not be a general `sessions.abort` capability.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit queue clearing
recommendation.body: Keep `clearQueued` as an additive opt-in parameter and merge after the owner confirms that selected-session Stop should discard that session's queued successor work.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete ownership signal available is repeated authorship of the proposed selected-session stop path; a Gateway/session owner should make the final contract decision.
